tools.name: turso_get_current_user
tools.description: Show the user who owns the API token. Turso API: GET /v1/user.

tools.name: turso_get_organization
tools.description: Show the details of the organization. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}.

tools.name: turso_get_organization_subscription
tools.description: Show the organization's current subscription plan and its details. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/subscription.

tools.name: turso_get_organization_usage
tools.description: Show the organization's billing-cycle usage: rows read and written, and total storage. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/usage.

tools.name: turso_list_organization_members
tools.description: List the members of the organization and their roles. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/members.

tools.name: turso_list_locations
tools.description: List the regions where a Turso group can run databases. Turso API: GET /v1/locations.

tools.name: turso_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups in the organization. A group holds databases in one or more regions. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/groups.

tools.name: turso_get_group
tools.description: Show one group. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/groups/{groupName}.

tools.name: turso_list_databases
tools.description: List the databases in the organization with their names, hostnames and groups. Optionally filter by group. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/databases.

tools.name: turso_get_database
tools.description: Show one database: its name, database id, hostname and block flags. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/databases/{databaseName}.

tools.name: turso_get_database_configuration
tools.description: Show a database's settings: size limit, blocked reads and writes, delete protection and allowed IPs. Turso API: GET .../databases/{databaseName}/configuration.

tools.name: turso_list_database_instances
tools.description: List the instances of one database: the primary and the replicas in each region of its group. Turso API: GET .../databases/{databaseName}/instances.

tools.name: turso_get_database_usage
tools.description: Show rows read and written and storage size for one database, per instance and in total. Dates default to the current calendar month. Turso API: GET .../databases/{databaseName}/usage.

tools.name: turso_query_database
tools.description: Run one SQL statement against a database and return the columns and rows. Turso enforces read-only: writes are rejected. Each call mints a read-only database token that expires after 30 minutes. Uses the libSQL HTTP API (POST https://<hostname>/v2/pipeline).

tools.name: turso_create_database
tools.description: Create an empty database in an existing group. The name is lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Creating a database can start billing. Turso API: POST /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/databases.

tools.name: turso_create_database_token
tools.description: Mint a token for one database. Read-only is the default. The returned JWT is a secret: treat it like a password. Turso API: POST .../databases/{databaseName}/auth/tokens.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "turso_create_database_token" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Mint a token for one database. Read-only is the default. The returned token is a secret, so treat it like a password.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: turso_query_database, turso_create_database_token · Private data: turso_get_current_user, turso_get_database, turso_get_database_configuration, turso_list_database_instances, turso_get_database_usage, turso_query_database, turso_create_database, turso_create_database_token · Public sink: turso_query_database, turso_create_database, turso_create_database_token · Destructive: turso_list_locations, turso_get_database_configuration, turso_query_database.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: turso_query_database, turso_create_database_token · Private data: turso_get_current_user, turso_get_database, turso_get_database_configuration, turso_list_database_instances, turso_get_database_usage, turso_query_database, turso_create_database, turso_create_database_token · Public sink: turso_query_database, turso_create_database, turso_create_database_token · Destructive: turso_list_locations, turso_get_database_configuration, turso_query_database

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
